zeus.explanation: Most versatile unit in the game, can be used everywhere.

nezha.explanation: Strongest PvE dps for both odyssey and spire, can clear most teams in odyssey with 4 lvl 1 units once divine.

cronus.explanation: Best support in the game, does everything. Full kit unlocked pretty much at base dupe. Relic is nice to have but not needed.
cronus.f2pInvestment: Base dupe, work on dupes after zeus/nezha

nuwa.explanation: Best tank in the game, can perma cc, can share damage between your units, can perma cc enemies and works at base dupe for all of that.
nuwa.f2pInvestment: Base dupe - wait or grab from mindsea

amunra.explanation: With relic 30, borrowed gear from zeus and while paired with meret/caishen can deal with a lot of teams. Flexible other 2 spots. Has some units he wants to avoid fighting such as yanluo.
amunra.f2pInvestment: Free unit - work on via shards / mindsea after zeus for dupes

dionysus.explanation: One of the few energy batteries the game has, has insane buffs but survival issues. If you can keep her alive it is highest dps increasing support atm.
dionysus.f2pInvestment: Base dupe - wait till it randomly drops

nyx.explanation: One of the most broken PvP units in entire game that can hard carry early game PvE but falls off later on and is mostly used as subdps/tech.
nyx.f2pInvestment: Base dupe - wait till it randomly drops

skadi.explanation: Closest dps to a celestial that we have in game currently, can clear most teams and doesn't contest teammates with hecate or any other meta team.

poseidon.explanation: Most accessible and best grouping tool aside amun, mres shred. Biggest performance jump out of all units at relic 10.

hecate.explanation: Only carry aside jingwei that can be used up till late game from standard units. Forms a core with yuelao and momus. Doesn't contest teammates with other carries.

khepri.explanation: Tech unit, used to push and group alongside poseidon. Decently tanky with relic investment.

tefnut.explanation: Good support, has 50% aoe dmg reduction and can cleanse debuffs. Pushback is nice.

momus.explanation: Best tank from standard units, does a lot of damage alongside hecate. Upgrade relic when you feel comfortable to invest in it or when team starts to struggle. His stats = Hecate stats.

iris.explanation: Has a bit of cc and dmg buff in aoe, can be used alongside poseidon to buff aoe dps.

hela.explanation: Can do some dmg and be used as subdps in very rare scenario to finish off enemies. With proper account investment she has no use for PvE anymore.

nemesis.explanation: Very rng based damage, will dash and instantly die at higher deficits. Completely unusable 61+.

meret.explanation: Best damage buffer in the game second only to Dionysus but unlike her provides insane survivability to allies and can tank herself. Requires properly connecting sun and moon targets.

heracles.explanation: Carry unit in yellow team. Groups up enemy and does 2 big bursts of damage. Avoid using into pan. Prio slot 2/4 for upgrading.

bastet.explanation: Recommended frontline unit, can be a solo carry up until 5 teams. Need to get some dodge% on slot 2/3.

phoenix.explanation: Good damage early on, subdps later on with infinite lives.

set.explanation: Lifesteal/Atk% buffer. Can be used as armor shred for diamond team.

athena.explanation: Used as a zeus buffer when you get divine zeus. High attack speed buff that benefits zeus judgement. Must invest in relic 20 if you have divine zeus.

sekhmet.explanation: Can be used to push enemy for grouping but that is all. Pretty useless overall.

ares.explanation: 5 second lifespan. Was used as a little stall for zeus but there is no need anymore for it due to newer units opening up spots.

geb.explanation: Big rock times you out as enemy, is paper as ally.

horus.explanation: Enemy horus executes your entire team after flying up, yours jumps and dies.

wenshen.explanation: Very good tech unit, staple for nezha team in odyssey. Has some tech use in spire. Her jinx debuff has higher prio than enemy skills so it can cancel super armor ones like artemis.

nuba.explanation: Good offtank subdps, has plenty of utility in kit. Overall a good unit. If lacking investment on dupes/relic she will just give enemy free energy.

anubis.explanation: Execute mechanic is pretty good, can cheese quite a few units to not revive via it.

pan.explanation: Plenty of cc in kit, one of only units with energy removal. Can be used to perma cc teams so they never ult.

jormungandr.explanation: Purely a grouping tool / bait for anubis ults. Can one shot units in pvp.

diana.explanation: Energy battery with high attack speed buff. Zeus/Nezha pet later on. Works at 1 dupe as battery. Invest in relic when you have divine zeus or if you are using nezha as carry.

capricorn.explanation: Mainly used as a tech unit for positioning, requires good understanding of how units act at start of fight. Used for grouping.

fengyi.explanation: Early game race carry, has no use outside of that. If you get lucky use her to place high then switch her out.

artemis.explanation: As enemy her arrows instakill you but when you use her she does 0 dmg.

demeter.explanation: Useless when on your team, times you out on enemy.

freya.explanation: Has 0 utility and just has healing which is useless. If you win with freya you could have won with empty slot.

mengpo.explanation: Infinite revives, battery, cc, dmg buffs, untargetable. Support with almost no weakness and with most complete kit a support could have.

caishen.explanation: Best energy battery in the game, used everywhere.

yuelao.explanation: Buffer/damage share unit tied with hecate and momus to form a trio carry comp for odyssey.

cancer.explanation: One of the few energy batteries the game has, best and only useful zodiac game has. Gives frontline energy and super armor.

jingwei.relicRecommendation: If going for zeus: 10-20 / If not going for zeus: 20-30
jingwei.explanation: Only carry aside hecate that is able to carry a team on her own from standard units that isn't a celestial up to T4 gear. Borrow her zeus gear instead of awakening her own gear.

hladgunnr.explanation: Meatshield. Invest in relic 30 only if prepared for the investment needed afterwards (awakening substats) or for heart spire.

yanluo.explanation: Tech unit, use when necessary for grouping enemies or messing up their skills.

prometheus.explanation: Just unlock the relic for the cage drop, tech unit for pushback/taking aggro.

isis.explanation: Free unit, can be used first few days for stages but is easily replaceable. 2nd best bossing unit after zeus but for both f2p and whales it is a troll investment.
isis.f2pInvestment: Can rush divine for 5 lvl 300 early game

ullr.explanation: Protection unit for PvP carry such as nezha.
ullr.f2pInvestment: Get divine after everyone above is divine

surtr.explanation: No use, garbage multipliers, garbage kit.
surtr.f2pInvestment: Get divine after everyone above is divine
